answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch. Every claim climbs the canyon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the cedar re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the vault of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
